Page.title: Capabilities

Capability.title: Applied Research
Capability.subtitle: How We Learn What's True
Capability.Peek: We figure out what's actually going on before anyone starts building.
Capability.Description: We figure out what's actually going on before anyone starts building. That means talking to users, studying the market, running experiments, and reviewing the existing evidence. We draw on behavioral science, statistics, and deep domain knowledge.

Capability.title: AI Product Development & Management
Capability.subtitle: Strategy & Delivery
Capability.Peek: We help you build and manage AI products from concept to launch.
Capability.Description: We help you build and manage products in this AI age from concept to the first prototype through what ships and what happens after. That includes choosing the right models, designing how people interact with them, and making sure they keep working as things change.

Capability.title: Enterprise AI Agents
Capability.subtitle: Autonomous AI Systems
Capability.Peek: Our enterprise agents can do real work inside your company.
Capability.Description: Our enterprise agents can do real work inside your company — processing documents, coordinating between systems, handling the tasks your team shouldn't be doing manually, while running reliably, at scale.

Capability.title: Data and AI Strategy
Capability.subtitle: Governance, Advisory and Adoption
Capability.Peek: Together we'll figure out where AI fits in your organization.
Capability.Description: Together we'll figure out where AI fits in your organization, what data you need to get there, and how to adopt it without the usual mess. Governance plans, adoption playbooks, and honest assessments of what's ready and what isn't.
